title: Lost authenticator: recovery and MFA reset
summary: Use a saved recovery code, understand one-use codes, and enroll again after an administrator resets MFA.
scenes: No authenticator and no recovery codes

steps.say: If you lose the MERIT entry in your authenticator, start with your user name and password as usual.
Choose Can't access your authenticator? to see recovery options. An enabled email-code option may also be available on the previous screen.
Enter an unused recovery code saved during setup. It has ten characters; the hyphen is optional. Never share a recovery code.
onScreen: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · Recovery code * · Enter an unused ten-character recovery code. You can include or omit its hyphen. · Use recovery code and sign in

steps.say: Choose Use recovery code and sign in. A successful recovery code signs you in once; it does not repair or replace your authenticator.
actions: Selects “Use recovery code and sign in”

steps.say: A used code cannot work a second time. If it is rejected, use another unused code or ask for an MFA reset.
actions: Selects “Use recovery code and sign in”

steps.say: Contact your agency's MERIT administrator or help desk through your usual support channel. Give your user name and explain what you lost.
onScreen: No recovery codes available? · Contact your agency's MERIT administrator or help desk through your usual agency support channel. Give them your MERIT user name and explain that the authenticator entry is missing. · Ask them to verify your identity and reset MFA for your account. If you are an administrator, ask another administrator to help. Platform administrators should contact another platform

steps.say: Ask them to verify your identity and reset MFA. Administrators need another administrator; platform administrators need another platform administrator.
An MFA reset ends active sessions and invalidates old authenticator and recovery codes. Wait for your administrator to confirm it before restarting.
onScreen: Sign in again after an MFA reset

steps.say: After the confirmed reset, choose Sign in again after an MFA reset and enter your password. MERIT asks you to set up a new authenticator entry.
actions: Selects “Sign in again after an MFA reset”

steps.say: Add the new MERIT entry to your app, verify its current code, and save the new recovery codes. Use the new entry for future sign-ins.
actions: Types into Code from the app (hidden)
